source: NOAA WaveWatch III via Open-Meteo Marine API

quality.atmospheric_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (temperature_2m, pressure_msl, 10 m wind)
quality.notes: NOAA NOMADS WW3 GRIB endpoints returned 403 from this environment and no GRIB2 decoder was installed. Open-Meteo serves the same NOAA WW3 fields as JSON, which we consume directly. The API requires equal-length lat/lon arrays; we fetch a 17x17 square over the display bbox and bilinearly interpolate to the 17x21 display grid. Atmospheric 10-m wind is pulled from api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast on the same grid+timeline.

native_mesh.mesh_selection: all faces whose native lon/lat bbox intersects USEC-MD
native_mesh.pages_representation: precomputed native-mesh contours; raw nodes/faces kept out of Pages payload due 25 MiB file limit

tide_harmonic_source.range_definition: max-min over complete native HTP horizon
tide_harmonic_source.method: complete ADCIRC face-bbox intersection; full native HTP horizon; native depth mask; no regular-grid reprojection; no CO-OPS interpolation

validation.model: NOAA STOFS HTP + CO-OPS harmonic residual calibration
validation.calibration: complex harmonic residuals; training window only
validation.promotion_gate: LOO coverage and held-out RMSE no worse than untouched STOFS

tide_range_definition: full native HTP horizon max-min at native mesh nodes

tide_range_contract.mask: tide_water_cells; at least two corners finite across the complete horizon
tide_range_contract.missing_policy: null; never interpolate land or missing corners

source.range_definition: max-min over complete native HTP horizon
source.method: complete ADCIRC face-bbox intersection; full native HTP horizon; native depth mask; no regular-grid reprojection; no CO-OPS interpolation

native_mesh.representation: precomputed native-mesh contours; raw nodes/faces kept out of Pages payload due 25 MiB file limit

phase_tiles.definition: combined-signal stage from total HTP value and edge-safe time derivative; high/falling/low/rising; same native triangles as co-range
